name: Anhui Province Natural Gas DevelopmentCo.,Ltd.
summary: Anhui Province Natural Gas Development Co., Ltd. is a Chinese company focused on the establishment, operation, and oversight of natural gas pipeline systems within Anhui province. Its extensive infrastructure features approximately 1,100 kilometers of pipelines and 38 transmission stations. The company's services include providing natural gas to both residential and commercial customers, maintaining natural gas pipeline facilities, and retailing natural gas appliances and related items. Founded in 2002, the firm is headquartered in Hefei, China.
